# 9LMNTS Studio // Master Interactive Creative Operating System (V5)

> 9LMNTS Studio (Nine Element Studio), founded by Creative Director & Lead Architect Darnley Sanon in Ottawa, Canada, is an entertainment technology agency and sovereign software infrastructure provider bridging 24/7 Creator Operating Systems, 8-Contender Live Competition Engines, WebAR Phygital Streetwear, and Project LOA transmedia IP.

- **Agency Sprints & WebAR**: Starter ($1,500 CAD), Pro Custom ($2,500–$3,500 CAD), Enterprise Scale ($5,000 CAD)
- **Monthly Retainers**: Growth/Pro ($1,500/mo), Premier ($2,500–$3,500/mo), Enterprise ($5,000/mo capped)
- **9LMNTS OS Series**: Free Beta ($0 upfront, 80/20 split), Maintenance ($500/mo), Pro ($500 setup, 90/10 split), Elite ($1,500 setup, 95/5 split), Enterprise Custom ($5,000 setup, 100/0 split)
